subject: Post-call recap: buying path, stakeholders & MAP draft
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meditech.io>, procurement@meditech.io
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: buying path, stakeholders & MAP draft

Hi Elaine / Meditech team — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: anonymized clinical note embeddings for search and triage.
- POC scope: 2-week pilot, 200k tokens/day, integrations to their internal staging S3.
- Decision signals: accuracy on recall/top-5, inference latency under 200ms P95, and per-token cost below $0.0009.

Open questions we promised to confirm:
1) Economic buyer / procurement owner — who signs the PO?
2) Security evidence baseline — you mentioned SOC 2 and data retention language; can you confirm the specific artifacts procurement needs?
3) Commercial constraints — any required contract clauses beyond standard SLAs?

Proposed MAP (attached): high-level milestones and owners. I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a short procurement Qs doc I captured during the call. Please review and tell me where to adjust timelines.

Immediate asks (can you confirm by end of week?):
- Confirm economic buyer (name + email) and procurement reviewer cadence
- Desired POC start week (we tentatively proposed week of May 10)
- Any mandatory legal language for data residency/retention

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), procurement-questions.pdf (notes)

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP with confirmed owners once we hear back.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Schedule: calendly.com/aditya-redwood
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meditech.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meditech.io
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: buying path, stakeholders & MAP draft

Aditya — thanks for the summary, spot on. A few clarifications: 

- Economic buyer is Victor Hale, VP Product (victor.hale@meditech.io). He will sign the PO but procurement handles the redline.
- Procurement lead is procurement@meditech.io (Sarah Chen). They will want the following evidence up front: SOC 2 Type II report, data retention policy, data deletion process description, and sample audit logs.
- Legal will ask for a 30-day data deletion SLA in the POC addendum and standard indemnity language — I’ll flag if they require anything stricter.

POC timeline: May 10 start works. We expect one internal engineering owner and a product reviewer. Acceptance criteria: recall >= 85% on our sample set, P95 latency < 200ms, and no data exfiltration risk in the integration.

I attached the procurement Qs I promised from our side. Happy to jump on a 30-minute follow-up if needed.

— Elaine
Elaine Park | Head of Integrations
Meditech Health

Attachments: procurement-questions.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meditech.io>, procurement@meditech.io
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: buying path, stakeholders & MAP draft

Team — capturing the MAP updates and owners after Elaine’s clarifications. I’m sharing the action plan here so we can move quickly.

Updated MAP (summary):
- Milestone 1 — POC kickoff prep (owner: Laura) — deliverables: staging S3 access checklist, integration runbook, data contracts; target complete: 2027-05-07.
- Milestone 2 — POC execution (owner: Priyom) — deliverables: evaluation harness, test dataset ingestion, performance report; target: 2027-05-24 (2-week execution window starting 2027-05-10).
- Milestone 3 — Procurement & legal sign-off (owner: Aditya) — deliverables: draft POC addendum, SOC2 evidence bundle, PO template; target: 2027-05-05 for initial redline review.
- Milestone 4 — Acceptance review (owner: Elaine / Meditech) — deliverable: acceptance checklist & report; target: 2027-05-26.

Action items I assigned in the attached MAP-draft-v1.xlsx:
- Laura: compile staging access steps + sample integration test by 2027-05-04.
- Priyom: prepare evaluation harness and baseline embedding metrics by 2027-05-09.
- Aditya: assemble SOC2 summary + audit log excerpt (SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf) and send to procurement@meditech.io by 2027-05-03.

Questions / risks to flag for AE <> Solutions <> Security:
- If legal demands data residency changes, timeline may slip; we should map fallback options (tokenization + on-prem proxy).
- Procurement might ask for DPA changes; need Legal review window (lead time = 5 business days).

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9283) and MAP draft (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-map-draft).

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Next step: Laura / Priyom — please ACK and confirm if the internal owners above work. Elaine — can you confirm Victor (economic buyer) is happy with the May 10 start and that procurement will do an initial redline by May 5?

— Aditya
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meditech.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meditech.io
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: buying path, stakeholders & MAP draft

Aditya / team — all good from our side. Confirming: 
- Victor is aligned to sign the PO once procurement and legal clear the POC addendum.
- Procurement (Sarah) will target an initial redline by 2027-05-05; I copied them on this thread.
- May 10 kickoff is on — internal engineering owner will be assigned this afternoon.

Please go ahead with the SOC2 bundle and the MAP updates. I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for 2027-05-10 10:00am PT and send calendar invites.

— Elaine
